# Game8

> > Game8 delivers comprehensive gaming walkthroughs, guides, and news with a focus on Japanese games, global releases, and popular titles like Roblox, Resident Evil, Minecraft, and Pokemon.

Game8 is a premier gaming resource platform originating from Japan, providing detailed walkthroughs, item databases, collectible guides, and news coverage for AAA titles, indie games, and mobile releases. The site specializes in actionable game guides including fishing mechanics, weapon lists, ability unlocks, and collectible locations across diverse gaming platforms.

## Key Topics

- Game walkthroughs and guides
- Japanese gaming coverage
- Roblox guides (Abyss)
- Resident Evil series
- Monster Hunter Stories
- Pokemon games
- Minecraft references
- Hollow Knight: Silksong
- Mobile gaming
- New game releases
- Fishing and collectible guides
- Weapons and equipment databases
- Gaming news and reviews

## Core Pages

- [Game8 Homepage](http://game8.co/): Main hub for gaming walkthroughs, news, and guides from Japan

## Game Databases and Reference

- [List of All Items | Minecraft](https://game8.co/games/Minecraft/archives/377467): Comprehensive inventory items list with categories and uses for Minecraft
- [List of All Weapons and Guns | Resident Evil Requiem (RE9)](https://game8.co/games/Resident-Evil-Requiem/archives/582196): Complete weapons list for Leon and Grace in Resident Evil Requiem (RE9)

## Collectibles and Location Guides

- [All 15 Duck Locations | Abyss (Roblox)](https://game8.co/games/Abyss-Roblox/archives/579490): Interactive map showing all 15 Duck collectible locations in Abyss Roblox
- [Eyefish Location and How to Catch | Abyss (Roblox)](https://game8.co/games/Abyss-Roblox/archives/580065): Guide to catching Legendary Eyefish in Spirit Roots caves (Abyss Roblox)

## Ability and Progression Guides

- [How to Unlock Wall Jump: Cling Grip Location | Hollow Knight: Silksong](https://game8.co/games/Hollow-Knight-Silksong/archives/549741): Tutorial for unlocking Cling Grip wall jump ability in Shellwood area
